name: Tokyo Night
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: A theme that celebrates the lights of Downtown Tokyo at night. Based on the Tokyo Night VS Code theme.

name: Nyx
author: not-night-but
description: Day's typical Nyx theme. Goddess of the night. I would avoid the light version :)

name: Blueberry Banana
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Blueberry Banana is an easy-on-the-eyes theme with a cyberpunkish feeling. A fork of the Blueberry Banana VS Code theme by Peter Shershov.

name: Glass
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Frosted, translucent surfaces inspired by macOS.

name: Monokai
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Vivid pink, green, and yellow accents on a warm charcoal background. Based on the classic Monokai palette.

name: Windows 98
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Inspired by the classic Windows 98 theme. No, it's actually win 98.

name: Gruvbox
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Retro and earthy: warm browns and creams with muted red, orange, and yellow accents. Based on the Gruvbox palette.

name: Ayu
author: Beekeeper Studio
description: Clean and minimal, with bright orange accents on soft, uncluttered backgrounds. Based on the Ayu palette.

description: Soothing pastels on soft, low-contrast backgrounds. Uses Catppuccin Latte for light mode and Mocha for dark.

name: Nord
